text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace puts on a magnificent run in 
the Kyodo News Hai. Yet all the spotlight 
in the stands goes to Mr. C.B. alone.

Indeed, that running was on a completely 
different level. That's precisely why she 
wants to surpass it. With that thought, 
Katsuragi Ace—

A challenge was thrown down to Mr. C.B. "A 
best-of-three showdown across the Classic 
Triple Crown!" This bold declaration 
spread across all of Japan in the blink of 
an eye.

The public mood was entirely convinced of 
Mr. C.B.'s landslide victory. However, 
Katsuragi Ace's friends felt differently. 
They cheered for her to do her best as 
their one and only 'Ace.'

Seeing her challenge the mighty reignited 
her passion for running. Katsuragi Ace 
firmly clenched her fist, declaring, 
"Let's fight together!"
